column7: validateAllowedOrigins refused a bare * but accepted https://*, https://*.example.com and http://*:8080, which go-chi/cors treats as patterns; with AllowCredentials true every matching origin got a credentialed grant. A * anywhere in an entry is now a startup refusal. Hardening (operator configuration only). Found by LF1 library-conformance fuzzing (finding LF1-CORS-wildcard-entry)
